source_title: Disney and the NFL Unveil Limited-Edition Mickey and Friends Super Bowl LXI Merch
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
No two fandoms draw more devotees than Disney and the National Football League, so naturally, their partnership makes perfect sense.
Fans first got a taste in August 2026 when the duo debuted its first-ever Disney x Champion NFL clothing capsule , and given the response, the pair just announced a season-long initiative tied to Super Bowl LXI. The ongoing collaboration promises exclusive product drops in the months leading up to the Big Game, kicking off on Thursday, Oct. 29 with two limited-edition merchandise collections: Disney x Champion Super Bowl LXI apparel (tees and crewneck sweatshirts), plus Disney x FOCO clear stadium bags and collectibles (plushes, bobbleheads and figurines). Starting with the former, the Road To Super Bowl capsule builds upon Champion’s larger selection of Disney character-clad NFL team gear introduced a few months back.
Champion x Disney Women’s Road To Super Bowl LXI Sweatshirt
Champion X Disney Road To Super Bowl LXI Mickey & Friends Powerblend Sweatshirt
Champion X Disney Road To Super Bowl LXI Mickey & Friends T-Shirt
As for FOCO , the lineup leans heavily into the collectible category, as can be expected with the officially licensed fan merchandise brand. But while figurines, bobbleheads, bag charms, blind boxes and stuffed animals lead the charge, FOCO’s clear stadium bags certainly take center stage. Available for all 32 teams, the crossbody is equal parts practical and playful. Customers can preorder the full product line now with expected November ship dates.
Kansas City Chiefs x Disney Mickey Mouse Clear Crossbody Bag
Available for all 32 teams . Ships no later than Nov. 10.
Los Angeles Rams x Disney Mickey Mouse Foocoos Clip-On Plush Blind Box
Available for all 32 teams . Ships no later than Nov. 27.
“Sports is a growing area for Disney Consumer Products, reaching highly engaged audiences and sitting at the center of culture,” says Paul Gitter, executive vice president of global licensing at Disney Consumer Products. “As ESPN brings fans along the road to Super Bowl LXI , these products give them another way to connect with the teams, athletes and stories they love, while Mickey & Friends bring a uniquely Disney expression to the heart of NFL culture.”
As the season progresses and Super Bowl LXI inches closer, the collection will grow to include Mickey and Friends-inspired product drops from Crocs, Just Play, New Era, WinCraft and more from Champion. Stay tuned.
